# Cricut AutoPress™ 2 – 12 x 12 vs. Cricut AutoPress™ 2 – 15 x 15: Which Automatic Heat Press Is Right for You?


-
-
-


3 November 2026


[Cricut](https://cricut.com/blog/author/cricut/)


---


The Cricut AutoPress line is perfect for bigger projects and batch-making, and with two sizes available, anything is possible.


Choosing the right automatic heat press depends on a few key factors: the types of projects you make, how often, the materials you work with, how much control you want, and how much room you have in your workspace.


Because both Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 and Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 were both designed to deliver an approachable, automatic pressing experience, deciding which Cricut AutoPress is right for you comes down to the types of projects you want to make.


## Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 vs Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15: the quick answer


Think of the two models this way:


- **Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12** is a good choice for makers who want automatic pressing, consistent pressure of 110 lbs, and a 12 in x 12 in heat plate for everyday projects like standard T-shirts, tote bags, and pillowcases, and want to work in smaller batches.
- **Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15** is a more flexible choice for frequent makers, those with a small business, and higher-volume crafters who want a larger 15 in x 15 in pressing area, adjustable pressure up to 220-lbs, and want to take on larger projects and advanced heat-transfer materials, like Puff Iron-On.


The biggest functional difference between the two Cricut AutoPress 2 models is the size, machine control, and pressure. Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 is designed to deliver consistent automatic pressure of 110 lbs with an integrated control panel, while the pressure for Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 can be adjusted up to 220 lbs, and has a movable Control Pod for flexibility to operate the heating pressing how and when you want.

## The biggest differences: size, pressure, materials, and footprint


The biggest differences between Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 and Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 are heat plate size, pressure controls, project and material compatibility, and overall workspace needs.


### Heat plate size


Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 has a 12 in x 12 in pressing area, making it a practical fit for standard-size designs and a range of everyday projects.


Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 includes a 15 in x 15 in pressing area. The extra space means you can work with larger designs, XL T-shirts, sweatshirts, blankets, and more. Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 is also a great choice for batch production.


### Pressure controls


Another difference between the two Cricut AutoPress 2 models is pressure control. Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 keeps the pressure experience simple with consistent automatic pressure of 110 lbs.


On the other hand, Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 includes adjustable pressure settings from 45 to 220 lbs.


### Project and material compatibility


If you typically make projects that don’t require adjustable pressure, like Everyday Iron-On and glitter iron-on, Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 keeps things simple. But if you want the ability to fine-tune pressure for different materials, choose Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15. The additional control is useful when working with materials and projects that require more precise pressure settings, such as specialty materials like Puff Iron-On and[Cricut Iron-On Kits](https://cricut.com/en-us/search?q=iron-on+kits) that include sublimation glitter, printable holographic, and printable glow-in-the-dark.


## Integrated pressing experience in Design Space


The optional integrated pressing experience inside the Design Space app takes the guesswork out of heat pressing. Both Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 and Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 connect to the Design Space app via Bluetooth®, allowing you to control your heat press right from your phone while also providing step-by-step guidance for your projects.


Simply select your material and blank type in the interactive Heat Guide to get recommended time, temperature, and pressure settings. You can even send the recommended time and temperature settings directly to your heat press from the app to make project setup quick and easy.


### How it works


1. Select your heat press model.
2. Choose your heat-transfer materials and base.
3. Send the settings directly to your heat press via Bluetooth®.
4. Get step-by-step guidance for an effortlessly easy pressing experience.


## Workspace, storage, and everyday setup


A bigger heat plate means a larger machine, so consider your workspace. Do you have a dedicated place to keep your heat press, or do you need something you can easily store? A flat, stable, well-ventilated workspace with enough room around the machine is also required.


At 24.54 lbs, Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 is significantly lighter than Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 at 41.9 lbs. The smaller dimensions can also make it easier to fit into a home craft room or shared workspace.


Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 requires more table space and a sturdier setup. You’ll want to account for the machine’s total size, loading area, and the space needed to safely operate it.


## Which plate size is right for your projects?


The best way to choose a heat press is to think about the size of the designs you make most often.


If you create designs that are 12 in x 12 in or smaller, Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 is a great choice for projects like:


- T-shirts
- Standard-size apparel designs
- Totes
- Pillows
- Home décor
- Gifts for family and friends
- Team or event projects
- Small batches
- Everyday heat-transfer projects


If you create designs that are up to 15 in x 15 in, Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 is a great choice for projects like:


- Large T-shirts
- Sweatshirts
- Full-size apparel designs
- Oversized totes
- Pillowcases
- Blanket corners
- Larger home décor textiles
- Larger batches and multiples


## Consistent pressure vs. adjustable pressure


The pressing experience with Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 is intentionally simple: the heat press provides consistent 110 lbs of automatic pressure, so you can focus on setting up your project and following recommended time and temperature settings based on the material you’re working with.


The adjustable pressure of Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 becomes part of your customizable workflow, allowing you to adjust pressure in increments of 5 lbs, so that you can match different project requirements, from 45 to 220 lbs.


## Materials: HTV, sublimation, DTF transfers, and Puff Iron-On


Both Cricut AutoPress 2 models are designed to work with basic iron-on projects.


For common HTV projects,[sublimation, and Infusible Ink](https://cricut.com/blog/sublimation-and-infusible-ink-with-cricut/) , Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 is a natural choice if your project designs generally fit within the 12 in x 12 in pressing area, and you value a simpler pressure experience.


Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 gives you the ability to work with advanced and higher-demand materials, like Puff Iron-On and specialty[Cricut Iron-On Kits](https://cricut.com/en-us/search?q=iron-on+kits) . The 15 in x 15 in heat plate accommodates larger designs, including[DTF Transfers](https://cricut.com/blog/dtf-transfers-explained/) for XL T-shirts and big tote bags. Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 also provides pressure control that can be useful when following material-specific settings. The built-in presets include a setting for Puff Iron-On, alongside settings for Iron-On, DTF Transfers, and Infusible Ink.


For any heat-transfer material, it’s important to follow the recommended settings in the[Cricut Heat Guide online](https://cricut.com/en-us/heatguide?utm_source=chatgpt.com) or in the integrated pressing experience in Design Space.

## Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 and Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 shared features


Despite some differences, both Cricut AutoPress 2 models share the same vision: make heat pressing faster, easier, and more consistent.


Both provide:


- Zero Effort™ hands-free automatic pressing
- Automatic press and release
- Auto-mode that is perfect for batching
- Dry, even, edge-to-edge heat up to 410°F / 210°C
- Adjustable time and temperature
- Four built-in customizable presets
- Bluetooth connectivity to Cricut Design Space®
- Cricut Heat Guide support with guided settings and instructions
- Full slide-out trays for easier loading and unloading
- Support for materials up to 1.8 in (4.5 cm) thick
- Auto shut-off after 15 minutes
- An experience designed to make pressing faster, easier, and more consistent


## What to consider when choosing the right Cricut AutoPress 2 for you


Before you make your choice, consider a few questions:


### *How big are my typical projects?*


If a 12 in x 12 in heat pressing area covers the designs and blanks you use most often, the smaller plate of Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 may be all the space you need. If larger designs are a regular part of your workflow, consider Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15.


### *How much pressure control do I want?*


Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 uses consistent automatic 110-lb pressure every time you press. Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 allows you to adjust pressure for different projects, from 45-220 lbs.


### *How do I expect my making to grow or change?*


Try to think beyond your next project. Consider whether you’ll be making occasional gifts and small batches, or whether you’ll increasingly work with larger apparel, advanced materials, and higher-volume orders.


Once you know the answer to those questions, the choice between the two Cricut AutoPress 2 models becomes much more intuitive.


## Which Cricut AutoPress 2 Should You Buy?


The best way to decide which Cricut AutoPress 2 heat press to buy is to think about the types of projects you make most often.


Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 is a good choice if you:


- Want a straightforward, automatic heat press
- Typically make standard-sized apparel and everyday projects, like T-shirts, totes, pillowcases and decor
- Make in smaller batches
- Prefer consistent, automatic pressure vs. adjustable pressure
- Want fewer settings to manage


The hands-free automatic pressing and consistent pressure of Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 delivers a simple, straightforward making experience.


Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 is the right choice if you:


- Regularly make larger apparel and projects
- Need a larger 15 in x 15 in pressing area
- Want to work with larger designs
- Make sweatshirts, oversized totes, and blankets
- Create in larger batches, multiples, or run a small business
- Work to work with specialty materials like, Puff Iron-On
- Need or want adjustable pressure up to 220 lbs
- Prefer a movable Control Pod for added flexibility


Get more pressing area and control with Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 to make more your way.
